name: enter_chat
description: PID-targeted mixed text injection (Hangul via Interception + Korean IME, other text via WM_CHAR), with characters-per-second, per-character jitter, and an optional final Enter.

request.jitter_ms: uniform +/- random offset added to each character pause
request.jamo_delay_ms: delay between jamo keys inside one Hangul syllable; <= 0 means 8

result.chars: code points sent (or planned in dry-run)
result.keys: text key events (jamo keys + WM_CHAR units)
result.failed: code points that could not be sent

flags.EC_FLAG_NO_START_COMMIT: skip the initial IME composition flush

prerequisites: interception.dll next to the host executable or on PATH
Korean IME in Hangul (한) mode when ImmGetContext and the default IME window are unavailable

files.include/enter_chat.h: public API, request/result structs, status codes, flags
files.src/enter_chat.c: orchestrator: validation, target, UIPI, focus, IME, text, Enter
files.src/ec_target.c: PID -> window, focus resolution, foreground, integrity/UIPI
files.src/ec_keyboard.c: Interception loading, scancode injection, VK/ASCII mapping
files.src/ec_hangul.c: Hangul decomposition, Korean layout/IME prepare/restore, commit
files.src/ec_text.c: UTF-8 conversion, WM_CHAR/SendInput, sleep, RNG, jitter
files.cli/enter_chat_cli.c: CLI parser, BOM-aware text loading, JSON output
files.examples/build_example.bat: builds the C API example into bin/example_call.exe
files.build.bat: MSVC x64 build for DLL, two CLIs, and tests
